summary: Sandbach United fielded an unchanged lineup in their midweek clash against New Mills at Hind Heath Road, looking to secure back-to-back home wins following Saturday's narrow victory over Stafford Town. The match remained tightly contested through the opening stages with chances at both ends, including efforts from Saul and Bev for Bach, but both sides struggled to break the deadlock in what proved to be a competitive encounter in arid conditions.
